heuristic_baseline_audit.finding: Heuristic year_eval > year_base achieves 84.23% on all 482 dev cases and 81.67% on the 60 sampled dev cases because macroeconomic indicators generally grew over historical decades. C1's 75.0% does not exceed this simple heuristic, demonstrating strong shortcut risk on monotonic indicators.

counterfactual_composition_audit.finding: Of the 30 counterfactual pairs in Run 02, 27/30 (90.0%) belong to TRAIN entities (GBXE, DVPR, RRHM), and only 3/30 belong to DEV entities. Thus, Run 02's 66.67% counterfactual flip rate is predominantly an in-domain training retention score rather than held-out generalization.

statistical_limitations.cluster_dependence_note: Exact McNemar tests computed per example in Run 02 assumed independent trials, but examples cluster heavily by indicator and entity. With only 2 held-out entities, true cluster-adjusted uncertainty is substantial.
